slots.hypothesis: Head 4's core is the strongest real source in the snapshot. Paid ablation shows it scores +1.21 alone, its necessity is +1.73, swapping Amt for Volume changes nothing, the 10/20/40-day windows plateau, and train and valid are symmetric. It is scale-free in amount, price and share count, so it cannot be a folded size, liquidity or price proxy. The family control holds head 4 itself, so only new information outside the core scores. The 16 seeds use peripheries never seen before (the snapshot only had {sqrt}), in four groups. (1) Level vs change: 20-day minus 60-day median, 50-day time-series rank, today's deviation and the past week's deviation. (2) Finer timing: closing-auction share, first-minute share, timing of the heaviest 10% of minutes, the timing centroid of |Ret|, gini times centroid, and centroid instability. (3) One-sided or non-monotone transforms: push the latest 10% down, lift the earliest 20%, absolute distance from the cross-sectional median. (4) Interactions inside the most front-loaded 20%: abnormal turnover, 15-day overnight return, and the 20-day time-series correlation of centroid with daily return. The seeds avoid pure smoothing (rank-ban risk with head 4), grouping by control variables, and stacking on kurt.

Unsmoothed direction of the intraday return distribution, plus a split of returns by volume intensity. The round-1 lesson was that raw day_kurt(Ret) (+0.97) beat every pre-smoothed version (0.46-0.61), and skew, signed jumps and imbalance were only ever tested smoothed. Two lines are tested. (a) Tail direction: raw skew, the ES-ratio hi/lo rank difference, skew times kurt, the signed mean of the largest-|Ret| minutes and its 20-day median, the raw Σr|r|/Σr², and the 30-day maximum daily return. (b) Return by volume intensity (after Admati-Pfleiderer, high-volume minutes carry the information): the mean return of the heaviest-Amt minutes (raw, 15-day mean, minus the day's mean minute return), amount-weighted minus equal-weighted minute return and its 20-day median, corr(Ret, Amt), corr(|Ret|, Amt), and the share of up-minutes ranked against the daily return. All 15 seeds are scale-free and none fold or segment control-variable levels.
